title: Nether chambers
description: Adds custom trial chambers, mace, boss and items to the nether
body:
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/f4ngn375YW4" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe> 

**Custom nether trial chambers**, **boss**, **mace** and **items**. Can you conquer the challenge and obtain the **magma mace**? Custom mace allows you to have built in wind charges with the mace and its crafted with 9 nether core shards. **Magma heart** gives you op effects and deals damage to mobs around you and has 16 durability. Magma night is an op version of the wither skeleton and has way more health, it drops the magma heart, mentioned earlier and only 1 spawns per chamber. 

This mod adds: 
1. Magma mace: Mace with built in wind charges. 
2. Magma knight: Mob with lots of health and gives withering effect. (one spawns per chamber). 
3. Magma heart: Drops from the magma knight, has 16 durability and gives enchanted golden apple effects and deals damage to mobs around you. 
4. Nether chambers: A nether varient of the trial chambers with all that was was mentioned above. 
5. Variants of the trial key and ominous trial key for the vaults in the nether, they don't work for the overworld and vise versa.
